A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 12-page versions of Simple Policy Optimization. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–C are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v7 reports original MuJoCo and Atari experiments, network-scaling evaluations, and objective-function optimization results in Section 6 and Appendices A/C.

after.justification: v8 retains these original empirical results, including algorithm comparisons, network-scaling experiments, and appendix Atari evaluations.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 and the SPO objective in Equations (16)/(18) are unchanged, including advantage estimation, policy/value losses, entropy regularization, and parameter updates.

E1.justification: Both retain the same six MuJoCo-v4 environments, Atari 2600 game coverage, and network-scaling scenarios. The added foundation-model fine-tuning discussion provides background only.

E2.justification: Figure 4 retains PPO-Clip, PPO-Penalty, SPU, PPO-RB, TR-PPO, TR-PPO-RB, and RPO. PPO remains the comparator in the network-scaling and Atari experiments.

E3.justification: Training budgets, network configurations, normalization, evaluation metrics, return-averaging windows, and Table 2 hyperparameters are unchanged. Figure 6’s added ε = 0.2 explanation identifies an existing reference line.

E4.justification: The network-depth and minibatch-size sensitivity analyses, ResNet scaling experiments, and comparison of fppo, fspo, and fsimple retain the same evidence in Figures 5–7 and 9.

E5.justification: Both retain ten-seed algorithm comparisons with stratified bootstrap confidence intervals, five-seed depth comparisons, and three-seed mean/standard-deviation Atari curves. Table 1 merely changes 'five' to '5'.

E6.justification: Table 1’s returns and ratio deviations match exactly. All experimental plots, including appendix Figures 8–10, retain the same results; no numerical values, result entries, rankings, or empirical trends change.

T1.justification: The ε-to-ξ substitution disambiguates notation. Proposition 4.2 states δTV = sqrt(δKL/2), which v7 already supplied in its proof. The containment argument, other theorems, definitions, and mathematical reasoning are retained.

C1.justification: Figure 1 changes 'the first model-free algorithm' capable of training extremely deep networks end-to-end to 'a novel model-free algorithm', withdrawing the priority claim. The abstract, contribution bullets, and conclusion otherwise retain their substantive claims.

C2.justification: The corrective-gradient explanation, interpretations of scaling and ratio-control results, explanation of fsimple’s behavior, and proposed future applications remain substantively unchanged. The new Impact Statement contains only generic societal-impact language.

D1.justification: v8 adds an explicit Simple-Policy-Optimization code hyperlink after the abstract, absent from v7. Appendix B’s hyperparameters and the disclosed ResNet modifications remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The introduction adds foundation-model fine-tuning references to Ouyang et al. (2022) and Black et al. (2023), while removing several application references. The batch-normalization footnote replaces Bjorck et al. (2021) with Bhatt et al. (2019). Central PPO/TRPO positioning remains intact.

P1.justification: v8 makes localized prose and notation edits, updates affiliations and publication text, and adds Acknowledgements and an Impact Statement. The main narrative and section/appendix ordering remain intact.

P2.justification: Captions receive limited edits, particularly Figure 6’s explanation of the existing red dashed ε = 0.2 line. Equations, front matter, and references undergo modest reflow; the figure/table set, plotted graphics, and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: The added code pointer improves reproducibility documentation, while distinct ξ/ε notation and Figure 6’s clearer caption improve readability. Figure 1 also narrows its priority claim. These limited improvements preserve the existing method and empirical evidence without introducing a material deterioration.
